verdicts.details: The boot fails on the chain id check before genesisApplied is reached. The path is reachable through gnoland start: StreamingGenesisProvider runs no ValidateAndComplete (none in gno.land/pkg/gnoland outside tests), and the merge base saved the doc before MakeGenesisState validated it. The check is an unchanged context line, so the merge base fails the same way; the diff stops new dirs from reaching this state and does not heal old ones. The data dir never applied a genesis, so the wipe loses nothing: Nit. Fix, a decision for the author: let an empty persisted chain id fall through to the reset when the height-0 key is absent, or name the invalid persisted doc in the error.
